title: Doozy Vape Co Big Drip Bubblegum Candy Shortfill E-Liquid 100ml
description: For flavour that really pops try Big Drip’s irresistible Bubblegum Candy, a deliciously authentic blend of fruity-sweet Bubblegum with a cool and refreshing spearmint finish on the exhale. This convenient 100ml shortfill bottle really helps your favourite e-liquid go the distance and comes with 25ml of free space for the addition of a nicotine shot to tailor your vape’s nicotine content to your exact preference. Its 70VG/30PG ratio makes it ideal for high-powered pod kits , mods and sub-ohm tanks .
